text: Application: 964 Turbo 3.3, initial version; German Porsche retrospective. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Published original Turbo rating as {"displacement_L":3.3,"power_PS":320,"power_kW":235}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: The historical European rating is not generalized to every market, catalyst version or later 3.6 engine. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO001].

Application: 964 Turbo S 3.3; German Porsche retrospective. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Published Turbo S rating as 381 PS. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Source distinguishes the 3.3 L Turbo S from the later 3.6 L Turbo. This is not a 993 Turbo S rating. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO002].

Application: 964 Turbo 3.6; Porsche Klassik retrospective technical table. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Nominal bore and stroke as {"bore_mm":100,"stroke_mm":76.4} mm. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Nominal engine geometry; no piston clearance, cylinder-wall thickness or machining tolerance is defined. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO003].

Application: 964 Turbo 3.6; Porsche Klassik retrospective technical table. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Published compression ratio as 7.5:1. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Specific to the 964 Turbo 3.6 in this comparison; do not transfer to 993 M64/60 or use as a measured combustion-chamber volume. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO004].

Application: 964 Turbo 3.6; Porsche Klassik retrospective technical table. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Published rated power and engine speed as {"engine_rpm":5500,"power_PS":360}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Published engine rating, not an independently acquired dynamometer map. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO005].

Application: 964 Turbo 3.6; Porsche Klassik retrospective technical table. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Torque figure with unresolved overboost label as {"reported_engine_rpm":4200,"reported_torque_Nm":520}. Evidence status: documentary_ambiguity. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: The table labels this row with overboost but gives no control strategy, duration or pressure. Retain the number as an attributed document statement; the label is not proof of a programmed overboost mode. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO006].

Application: 964 Turbo 3.6; Porsche Klassik retrospective narrative. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Low-speed torque point as reported as {"reported_engine_rpm":2400,"reported_torque_Nm":450}. Evidence status: manufacturer_retrospective_statement. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: A single reported point in a retrospective driving article, not an original engine map or proof of a flat torque plateau. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO007].

Application: 993 Turbo S / factory 450 PS example in Porsche Klassik retrospective. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Published rated power and engine speed as {"engine_rpm":6000,"power_PS":450}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: The historical factory 450 PS tune is separate from stock 408 PS and 430 PS versions; no ECU binary or boost map was acquired. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO008].

Application: 993 Turbo S / factory 450 PS example in Porsche Klassik retrospective. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Torque figure with unresolved overboost label as {"reported_engine_rpm":4500,"reported_torque_Nm":585}. Evidence status: documentary_ambiguity. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: The 2017 table labels the torque row with overboost. Neither the inspected official heritage page nor the one-page datasheet states torque or an overboost function. A contemporaneous model-specific document is required before treating the label as ECU or hardware behaviour. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO009].

Application: 993 Turbo S and 964 Turbo 3.6; German Porsche Klassik technical-table wording. Component: boost_control. The reviewed factual register records Unresolved retrospective overboost attribution as not established in this review. Evidence status: unresolved. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: The same overboost heading appears for the air-cooled and modern cars. The inspected documents do not establish an original 993 or 964 programmed overboost mode, its duration or its boost-pressure delta. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO010].

Application: 964 Turbo 3.3, initial catalyst-equipped version; German Porsche retrospective. Component: main_catalyst. The reviewed factual register records Published standard catalyst construction as Three-way metal catalyst. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Metal identifies the broad catalyst construction; substrate alloy, washcoat composition, cell density, wall thickness and catalyst dimensions are not disclosed. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO011].

Application: 964 Turbo 3.3, initial catalyst-equipped version; German Porsche retrospective. Component: wastegate_bypass_exhaust. The reviewed factual register records Published exhaust-flow architecture as Bypass tailpipe with its own catalyst and silencer; bypass gases do not pass through the regular main catalyst. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: The source attributes avoidance of additional main-catalyst backpressure to this routing. It gives no measured pressure loss, tube thickness, gas-temperature map or catalyst dimensions; do not transfer this layout to the 993 integrated-wastegate system. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO012].

Application: 996 Turbo at introduction; comparison with contemporary naturally aspirated 911. Component: engine_cooling_radiators. The reviewed factual register records Published total radiator-area increase as 50 percent. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Comparison concerns total radiator area. It is not a 50 percent heat-rejection increase, core thickness, measured cooling performance or radiator material specification. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO013].

Application: 996 Turbo original 420 PS version; German Porsche retrospective. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Published maximum torque as 560 Nm. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: No torque-curve coordinates or associated engine speed are supplied in this source. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO014].

Application: 997.1 Turbo 3.6 with optional Sport Chrono Paket Turbo. Component: boost_control. The reviewed factual register records Published maximum overboost duration as 10 s. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Conditional optional overboost under full acceleration; not continuous-duty operation or a 993 control feature. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO015].

Application: 997.1 Turbo 3.6 with optional Sport Chrono Paket Turbo. Component: boost_control. The reviewed factual register records Published overboost pressure increment as 0.2 bar. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Pressure difference in the midrange, not an absolute manifold pressure or compressor pressure ratio. No baseline operating pressure, inlet losses or compressor map is defined. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO016].

Application: 997.1 Turbo 3.6 with optional Sport Chrono Paket Turbo. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Published temporary overboost torque as {"increase_from_normal_Nm":60,"temporary_torque_Nm":680}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: The temporary torque depends on the optional overboost mode and its duration, not a continuous 680 Nm rating or evidence for a 993 map. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO017].

Application: 930 Turbo 3.3, historical factory special-request programme. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records Published optional factory power increment as {"increase_PS":30,"increase_kW":22}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: The retrospective describes the increment without identifying an ECU, turbocharger reference, compressor map or exact model-year/market implementation; no specific hardware package is inferred. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO018].

Application: Porsche Classic reproduction aluminium crankcases for unspecified larger-displacement 1990s 911. Component: main_crankcase. The reviewed factual register records Published reproduction-material family and CAD recovery as Aluminium crankcases made from stored blanks; machining data recovered with the Porsche 962 Group C race-engine reproduction project because old production drawings were no longer fully legible. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: This is a manufacturer account of reproduction engineering, not a released CAD drawing or evidence that every 1990s variant uses the same geometry or aluminium grade. M64/60 is not specifically named. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO019].

Application: Porsche Classic replacement crankcases for 1968–1976 911 F/G-series 2.0,2.2,2.4,2.7 L; early-911 comparison only. Component: main_crankcase. The reviewed factual register records Published reproduction material and applicability as {"displacements_L":[2.0,2.2,2.4,2.7],"material_family":"magnesium","model_years":"1968–1976"}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Exact magnesium grade and heat treatment are not published. These early naturally aspirated 911 case applications are not a 930 3.0, 993 M64/60, GT2 or GT1 case specification. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO020].

Application: Porsche Classic 2023 early-911 magnesium replacement-crankcase programme. Component: main_crankcase. The reviewed factual register records Published reproduction casting process as Sand casting from CAD-based moulds; cores use sand and a resin-containing binder and are destroyed after casting. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Current reproduction route; do not infer that every historical original case used this supplier/process or assign an undisclosed magnesium grade, porosity limit or minimum wall thickness. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO021].

Application: Porsche Classic 2023 early-911 magnesium replacement-crankcase programme. Component: main_crankcase. The reviewed factual register records Published machining route as {"machine":"five-axis CNC","tool_count":"more than 50 cutting, drilling and milling tools"}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Published manufacturing route, not a machining programme, tool diameter, datum definition or production tolerance. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO022].

Application: Porsche Classic 2023 early-911 magnesium replacement-crankcase programme. Component: main_crankcase. The reviewed factual register records Example material removal at milled surfaces as {"approximate_max_mm":4,"approximate_min_mm":3} mm. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: This is approximate machining stock removed at example milled surfaces. It is not finished case-wall thickness, total casting thickness or a permission to remove 3–4 mm from an existing 993 component. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO023].

Application: Porsche Classic 2023 early-911 magnesium replacement-crankcase programme. Component: main_crankcase. The reviewed factual register records Published dimensional-inspection scope as Individual inspection using 3D probing and comparison on a 3D coordinate measuring machine; complete inspection covers more than 1300 control dimensions. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: No individual coordinate, tolerance, inspection report or full drawing is released; the number of checks does not itself qualify an independently reproduced part. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO024].

Application: Porsche Classic 2023 early-911 magnesium replacement-crankcase programme; Carrera RS 2.7 prototype. Component: main_crankcase. The reviewed factual register records Published prototype-validation programme as A Carrera RS 2.7 prototype engine underwent multi-week dynamometer testing with defined loads and engine speeds, oil-particle checks, full teardown and separate crankcase-half inspection at Weissach. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: The source gives no full load spectrum, hours, temperatures, fatigue limits or measurement results. This factory test is not qualification of a 993 Turbo part or of any user-made case. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO025].

Application: Porsche Classic early-911 replacement-crankcase programme. Component: main_crankcase. The reviewed factual register records Published reproduction revision-traceability policy as Reproductions follow the last mature historical series revision; raw-part numbers identify that revision and purchased-part numbers are also marked. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Describes Porsche Classic traceability; it does not reveal CAD geometry, exact alloy chemistry, a specific 993 part revision or an equivalence certificate. Research record: [MEZGER-DEO026].

Application: 911 Carrera RSR Turbo 2.1, factory racing version, 1974. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records historical_displacement_and_power as {"displacement_L":2.1,"power_PS":500,"power_kW":368}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Rounded displacement and historical output; no power-peak rpm, boost pressure or alloy grade is specified. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R001].

Application: 911 Carrera RSR Turbo 2.1, factory racing version, 1974. Component: charge_air_cooling. The reviewed factual register records intercooler_presence as True. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Factory says charge-air cooling is fitted; cooler material, type, dimensions, effectiveness and outlet temperature are not established. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R002].

Application: 911 Turbo IMSA Supercar, Hans-Joachim Stuck championship version, 1993. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records historical_displacement_turbo_count_and_power as {"displacement_L":3.6,"power_PS":370,"power_kW":272,"turbocharger_count":1}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Specific IMSA historical version, not the 993 Turbo biturbo or a rated output for every 964 Turbo 3.6. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R003].

Application: 911 Turbo S Le Mans GT, factory GT racing version, 1993. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records historical_displacement_turbo_count_and_restricted_power as {"air_intake_restrictors":"required by racing regulations","displacement_L":3.16,"power_PS":480,"power_kW":353,"turbocharger_count":2}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Restrictor diameter, boost pressure and peak rpm are not given. Distinct from road Turbo S and later 993 GT2. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R004].

Application: 993 911 GT2, initial 1995 racing version. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records historical_displacement_and_power as {"displacement_L":3.6,"power_PS":450,"power_kW":331,"turbocharger_count":2}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Describes initial racing output, not the road GT2 M64/60R output and not all later race evolutions. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R005].

Application: 993 911 GT2 Evo, final racing development stages described by Porsche. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records historical_displacement_and_maximum_power as {"displacement_L":3.8,"power_PS_up_to":700,"power_kW_up_to":515}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Factory retrospective explicitly assigns 3.8 L and up to 700 PS to latest development stages; it does not establish one engine-code suffix, exact build year, boost, restrictors or connecting-rod alloy. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R006].

Application: 911 GT1, factory competition version, 1996. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records configuration_cooling_displacement_and_power as {"architecture":"six-cylinder boxer","cooling":"fully water-cooled","displacement_L":3.2,"position":"ahead of rear axle","power_PS":600,"power_kW":441,"turbocharger_count":2}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Historical factory race configuration, not museum Zakspeed 1998 rating of 404 kW and not a road GT1 rating. No exact alloy is given. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R007].

Application: 962 Dauer Le Mans GT, competition version, 1994. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records restricted_power_and_displacement as {"air_intake_restrictors":"required by racing regulations","displacement_L":3.0,"power_PS":680,"power_kW":500,"turbocharger_count":2}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Restricted Le Mans competition output; not an unrestricted Dauer road-car engine rating and not all 962C engines. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R008].

Application: Porsche 961, race derivative of 959, Le Mans 1986. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records historical_power as {"power_PS_approx":680,"power_kW_approx":500}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Factory describes approximate output for the 961 race derivative; not the 400 PS Dakar or 450 PS road 959 rating. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R009].

Application: 935/78 Moby Dick, 1978. Component: cylinders_and_cylinder_heads. The reviewed factual register records separate_cooling_media_and_head_valve_architecture as {"cylinder_heads":"water-cooled","cylinders":"air-cooled","valves_per_cylinder":4}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. Qualification: Explicitly separates cooling of cylinders and heads. Does not support labelling the complete 935/78 engine fully water-cooled or assigning an alloy grade. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R010].

Application: 935/77, factory racing evolution of 1976 935. Component: turbochargers. The reviewed factual register records reason_for_two_smaller_turbochargers as Two smaller turbochargers replaced the large single turbo to respond faster, reduce turbo lag and improve power controllability.. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Engineering recollection attributed to Norbert Singer; does not specify compressor maps, rotor dimensions, inertia, speed or a measured transient response time. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R011].

Application: 935 Baby, 1.4 L racing version, 1977, retrospective driving account. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records reported_response_transition_speed as {"above":"abrupt strong response","below":"restrained response","transition_engine_rpm_approx":5000}. Evidence status: factory_retrospective_driver_account. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Driver description attributed to Timo Bernhard; not a dyno measurement, turbo-shaft speed, peak-power rpm or engine rev limit. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R012].

Application: 959 road six-cylinder biturbo engine shown as IAA cutaway. Component: engine_block. The reviewed factual register records material_and_manufacturing_family as {"manufacturing_family":"casting","material_family":"aluminium alloy"}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. Qualification: German factory source explicitly says the block is cast from aluminium alloy. Exact alloy designation, casting method subtype, heat treatment and wall thickness are not given. Does not apply to 993 M64/60. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R013].

Application: 959 Paris-Dakar, restored second-place vehicle from 1986 rally. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records reason_for_reduced_output as {"power_PS":400,"power_kW":294,"reason":"low fuel quality"}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Factory links lower output to fuel quality. Fuel octane, fuel formulation, ignition map, boost pressure and injection calibration are not disclosed. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R014].

Application: 959 Paris-Dakar, rally adaptations, 1980s. Component: engine_management_units. The reviewed factual register records installation_height_reason as Engine control units were mounted high to reduce damage during river crossings.. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Rally packaging adaptation; source supplies no mounting coordinates, protection class, enclosure alloy or circuit specification. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R015].

Application: 959 Paris-Dakar, rally adaptations, 1980s. Component: oil_cooling. The reviewed factual register records location_and_rally_preparation as Oil coolers and oil lines beneath the rear fenders were prepared for rally conditions.. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Rear-fender location is stated. Cooler core geometry, material, tube wall thickness, oil pressure, capacity and temperature are not specified. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R016].

Application: 956/962 Group C PDK experiments beginning autumn 1984, mature system from 1987. Component: turbochargers_and_transmission. The reviewed factual register records qualitative_speed_retention_during_shifts as Very fast PDK shifts without interrupting drive torque kept turbochargers at high rotational speed.. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Qualitative statement only; no turbo-shaft rpm value, shaft inertia or shift time is supplied. Not a 993 manual-transmission operating condition. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R017].

Application: Type 935 and 936 six-cylinder turbo racing-engine development, 1977–1978. Component: cylinder_heads. The reviewed factual register records factory_engineering_chronology as Hans Mezger developed water cooling and the four-valve concept for the type 935 and 936 six-cylinder turbo engines during 1977–1978.. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Chronology establishes design lineage, not that all 935/936 versions are water-cooled or share identical heads, materials or component dimensions. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R018].

Application: 956/962 Group C 2.65 L engine development, 1981–1982. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records factory_documented_development_basis as The 2.65 L Group C engine for 956/962 was developed on the basis of type 935/936 engines.. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Factory lineage statement; does not prove interchangeability, identical alloys or dimensions, and does not cover every later 962 displacement. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R019].

Application: TAG-Turbo Formula 1 engine designed by Hans Mezger for McLaren, 1981–1987. Component: engine. The reviewed factual register records architecture_displacement_and_bank_angle as {"architecture":"V6","bank_angle_deg":80,"displacement_L":1.5}. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: A separate Hans Mezger-designed racing engine, not a 911 boxer/Mezger flat-six derivative. This source gives no exact alloys, metal thickness or compressor map. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-R020].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records supplier names for RR350 as ["RR350","Alufont-60","AlCu5NiCoSbZr"]. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-M001].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records copper composition range as [4.5,5.2] mass percent. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-M002].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records nickel composition range as [1.3,1.7] mass percent. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-M003].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records cobalt composition range as [0.1,0.4] mass percent. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-M004].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records titanium composition range as [0.15,0.3] mass percent. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-M005].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records manganese composition range as [0.1,0.3] mass percent. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-M006].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records zirconium and antimony table entry as {"element_label":"Zr & Sb","range":[0.1,0.3]} mass percent. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. The joint label does not resolve whether the stated range is individual or combined; do not infer a sum or separate limits. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-M007].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records silicon maximum content as 0.2 mass percent. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. The table introductory text defines single values as maximum contents, not nominal concentrations. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-M008].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records iron maximum content as 0.3 mass percent. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. The table introductory text defines single values as maximum contents, not nominal concentrations. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-M009].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records magnesium maximum content as 0.1 mass percent. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. The table introductory text defines single values as maximum contents, not nominal concentrations. Research record: [MEZGER-DE-M010].

Application: Rheinfelden RR350 / Alufont-60 casting alloy; generic grade reference for Xtreme aftermarket RR350 claim. Component: head_casting_material. The reviewed factual register records zinc maximum content as 0.1 mass percent. Evidence status: manufacturer_or_supplier_generic_material_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: These are Rheinfelden published grade data, not a certificate for any Xtreme casting heat or proof of original Porsche M64/60 material. The Xtreme RR350 claim remains separately sourced in MEZGER-M026. The table introductory text defines single values as maximum contents, not nominal concentrations.
